term: finite population profile and total welfare
definition: Stipulated Profile records a strictly positive natural count and a real mean on a common cardinal interpersonal scale. Profile.total is count times mean. The record gives no individual assignment, distribution, population identity, feasibility, ordinal-to-cardinal conversion or moral authority; no empty or infinite counts are admitted.
note: Independent mathematical control prompted by provisional Carneades captions, not a source interpretation. Common scale and arbitrary finite profiles require separate justification for any ethical application; Railton’s nonnumeric welfare criterion is not identified with this scale.
